Jul 7, 2025

## [The blanket I ordered looked nothing…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/686bfd4b04ff2601148f2eb6)
The blanket I ordered looked nothing like the photos, and was of subpar quality. It also took a very long time to ship, and came in no packaging. Unfortunately, I didn’t return it within the return window, which I should have. But as I had waited so long for the blanket, I decided against it. About a year on though the blanket is basically unusable as it is very pilled. I reached out to customer service and there was nothing that they could do to help. I think this brand is overpriced and of subpar quality.

July 7, 2025

Unprompted review

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 8, 2025

Hi there, thank you for reaching out and sharing your experience with us. We sincerely apologize that the blanket did not meet your expectations in terms of quality, shipping, and packaging. Your satisfaction is very important to us, and we truly appreciate your feedback—it helps us improve our products and service.
